description: The sentences a user reads when a gated call is refused or parked. Both hosts append them word for word, so Python (shared/park_prechecks.py, shared/hitl.py) and .NET (ParkPrechecks.cs, HitlGate.cs) are pinned to this one file.
not_submitted: I have not submitted anything for approval.
order_not_found: I could not find that order on your account. I have not submitted anything for approval.
return_not_found: I could not find that return on your account. I have not submitted anything for approval.
park_failed_reply: I could not submit that request for approval right now, so no changes have been made. Please try again in a moment.

parked.sentence: I have asked a team member to approve cancelling order 1f0e6a52-0000-4000-8000-000000000001 (ref: abcdef12). Nothing has changed yet; you will be notified once it has been reviewed.
I have asked a team member to approve processing the refund for return 2a0e6a52-0000-4000-8000-000000000003 (ref: bcdef123). Nothing has changed yet; you will be notified once it has been reviewed.
I have asked a team member to approve placing a backorder for product (ref: cdef1234). Nothing has changed yet; you will be notified once it has been reviewed.

role_refusal.sentence: Your account is not permitted to place backorders; that is limited to admin, seller accounts. I have not submitted anything for approval.
